description: Businesses licensed to do business in Delaware, from the Division of Revenue's official open data (daily): business and trade name, license category, license number, current validity period and address with coordinates. Search by name, trade name, license number, category or city. Corporate entity filings (Division of Corporations) are not included. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

category.description: License category contains, e.g. CONTRACTOR, RETAILER

name.description: Business or trade name contains, e.g. dupont

name: gov_delaware_business_search
title: Gov Delaware Business Search
